text: Automatically extracts memories from raw content like conversations, documents, files, and URLs.
quote: Send any raw content to Supermemory — conversations, documents, files, URLs. We extract the memories automatically.

text: Hybrid search mode searches both memories and document chunks together for best relevance.
quote: Use `searchMode: "hybrid"` for best results. It searches both memories and document chunks, returning the most relevant content.

text: Always-ready user profiles give comprehensive context without needing a separate search call.
quote: No search needed — comprehensive user info always ready Profiles update as users interact with your system

text: Container tags create hard-boundary namespaces so memories in one tag are never returned to another.
quote: A container tag is a hard boundary — its own namespace. Memories in one tag are never returned by a search scoped to another tag.

text: Remote MCP server lets an agent search Supermemory's own documentation while building an integration.
quote: Remote MCP that lets the agent search Supermemory documentation while it implements an integration.

text: Official CLI (npx supermemory setup) detects the project and launches or prints the integration flow.
quote: npx supermemory setup # detect project, launch/print integration flow

text: Runs as a single self-contained binary on your own hardware, the same engine as the hosted platform.
quote: Supermemory runs on your own hardware. It's the same memory engine behind the hosted platform... as a single self-contained binary.

text: Fully local stack — graph engine, embeddings, and LLM — so data never leaves your infrastructure.
quote: Local graph engine, local embeddings, local LLM. Your data never leaves the building.

text: MemoryBench Claude Code skill automates benchmarking your own memory implementation against Supermemory, Mem0, and Zep.
quote: MemoryBench ships a Claude Code skill that automates the entire process of benchmarking a custom memory implementation — yours — against Supermemory, Mem0, and Zep.

text: Memories can be created directly, bypassing document ingestion, and are immediately searchable.
quote: Create memories directly without going through the document ingestion workflow. Memories are embedded and immediately searchable.

text: Auto-syncs content from Google Drive, Gmail, Notion, OneDrive, and GitHub via real-time webhooks.
quote: Connectors Google Drive · Gmail · Notion · OneDrive · GitHub — auto-sync with real-time webhooks.

text: Multi-modal extractors handle PDFs, OCR on images, video transcription, and AST-aware code chunking.
quote: Multi-modal Extractors | PDFs, images (OCR), videos (transcription), code (AST-aware chunking). Upload and it works.

text: Supermemory MCP gives any MCP-compatible assistant a shared memory layer for team-wide context.
quote: Supermemory MCP gives every MCP-compatible assistant a shared memory layer, so technical and non-technical teams can collaborate with AI using the same authorized context.

text: Scope each end-user or tenant to a container tag and delete that container's content on request.
quote: Scope each end-user (or tenant) to a container tag. When the user requests deletion, delete that container's content via the API / console workf

text: Only unique ingested content is billed; repeated content costs nothing via a 100% prompt-cache discount.
quote: only unique content we ingest is billed; repeats cost nothing (100% prompt-cache discount, baked in).

text: Builds a living knowledge graph of facts on top of other facts rather than static embeddings.
quote: Supermemory builds a living knowledge graph of facts on top of other facts — not a static folder of embeddings

text: Automatically maintains evolving user profiles as collections of facts drawn from all interactions.
quote: User profiles are **automatically maintained collections of facts about your users** that Supermemory builds from all their interactions.

text: An official skill can be installed so coding agents use real endpoints/auth/containerTag rules instead of hallucinating APIs.
quote: Install the official skill so the agent uses the real endpoints, auth, and `containerTag` rules instead of hallucinating APIs

text: Connects to Google Drive, Gmail, Notion, OneDrive, GitHub, Granola, and a web crawler to sync documents into memory.
quote: Connect external platforms to automatically sync documents into supermemory. Supported connectors include Google Drive, Gmail, Notion, OneDrive, GitHub, Granola and Web Crawler

text: Retrieval offers three modes: document search (RAG), memory graph traversal, and user profile lookup.
quote: Retrieve three ways — document search (RAG), memory graph traversal, and user profile

text: Official TypeScript and Python client libraries wrap the API.
quote: Official clients wrap this API: TypeScript: npm install supermemory Python: pip install supermemory

text: Search can include related memories via graph relations, not just the top matching result.
quote: const results = await client.search({ q: "where does Alex work?", containerTag: "user_123", include: { relatedMemories: true }, });

text: Facts can be marked isStatic for permanent identity traits versus dynamic facts that can change.
quote: isStatic: true for permanent identity traits (name, hometown). Defaults to false

text: customId lets you update existing documents or conversations, reprocessing only what changed.
quote: Use customId to update existing documents or conversations. When you send content with the same customId, Supermemory intelligently processes only what's new.

text: Natural-language requests let the assistant pick the right Supermemory tool without needing tool names or code.
quote: Ask naturally. The assistant selects the right Supermemory tool without requiring code or tool names.

text: Spaces keep a team's documents, memories, and profile context scoped so retrieval doesn't mix unrelated work.
quote: A space keeps a team's documents, memories, and profile context focused, so AI retrieves the right knowledge without mixing unrelated work.

text: Metadata filtering lets you query memories by custom properties like category, status, or date.
quote: Metadata Filtering ... Query memories by custom properties like category, status, or date

text: You can tell Supermemory what content matters during ingestion to filter and prioritize what gets indexed.
quote: Tell Supermemory what content matters during ingestion. This helps filter and prioritize what gets indexed.

text: OAuth login prompts shown for connectors can be rebranded with your own app name and credentials.
quote: You can replace this with your own app name by providing your own OAuth credentials via the settings endpoint.

text: Buckets let you define custom topical categories to organize a user profile by subject.
quote: Buckets are custom topical categories for a profile ... group them by subject (e.g. preferences, goals, work).

text: SOC 2 compliance, HIPAA BAA availability, independent security audits, plus a self-hosted option.
quote: SOC 2 · HIPAA BAA · self-hosted option

text: A cheaper 'superrag' task type is available when content just needs to be searchable, not remembered.
quote: pass `taskType: "superrag"` if you just need it searchable, not remembered — that's 5x cheaper per token.

text: Ingested documents can be listed, fetched, updated, and deleted through the API.
quote: List, get, update, and delete your ingested documents
